meta.name: Taken: Natalee Holloway
meta.description: Beth Holloway, Natalee's mother, tells the full, definitive story of the case that's haunted her for the past 20 years - from the day of Natalee's disappearance to the dramatic confession two decades later.

videos.title: Natalee is Missing
videos.overview: On the last night of a senior trip to Aruba, 18-year-old Natalee Holloway disappears. Her mother Beth races to the island and a frantic search begins.

videos.title: Tangle with the Devil
videos.overview: As tensions with locals rise, the main suspect evades custody. The investigation reaches a grim turning point that leads Beth to work with the FBI.

videos.title: I Knew He Would Kill Again
videos.overview: Five years to the day Natalee vanished, a murder occurs halfway across the world. Soon after, Beth seizes the chance to confront her daughter's alleged killer.
